title: Fresh installs use Mainworks paths and unit names; existing Graphyard installs keep theirs
description: A fresh temporary home and checkout get ~/.config/mainworks/<install>/ (0600 files), a .mainworks directory and mainworks-* units, and nothing named graphyard; a temporary home seeded with ~/.config/graphyard, .graphyard and graphyard-* units runs status before and after the upgrade's install steps with nothing moved and nothing named mainworks.

steps.name: Install into a fresh home and upgrade a Graphyard home
